description: This file defines the 'EditScreen' React functional component used for editing or creating notes within a React Native application. It manages local state for note title and content, interacts with storage functions to retrieve and save notes, and handles user interactions such as saving or cancelling edits.

methods.name: EditScreen
methods.description: React functional component for editing or creating a note. Manages input state, fetches existing note data if editing, and handles save/cancel actions.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Async handler for saving the note. Validates input, calls create or update functions, and navigates accordingly.
